channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: The Valcour emergency system outage in Vermont continues into its second week. Dispatchers are manually entering data while officials evaluate alternative systems. Phone lines and emergency responses remain unaffected during the outage.

Rutland plans to lower the downtown speed limit to twenty-five miles per hour. Most drivers already travel below thirty miles per hour there. The change will help enforce speed limits and improve pedestrian safety.
A school bus slid down an embankment in Pomfret but no students were hurt. The Pomfret Fire Department managed traffic at the scene. The bus did not roll over, officials said.

Joshua Reynolds of St. Albans Town Vermont pleaded not guilty to federal robbery charges. He is accused of robbing a Highgate gas station at gunpoint last month. Reynolds faces up to twenty years in prison if convicted.
